card.name: Scattered numeric and title spots
card.fires_on: Fires on a few unrelated spots: the word Encyclopedia in the site header "Science Fair Project Encyclopedia", and the decimal point or space just before a number in statistics. It also fires on the end of "tartrazine".

modes.label: Encyclopedia header
modes.description: The word Encyclopedia in the repeated site title "Science Fair Project Encyclopedia" at the top of a page.
modes.example: Science Fair Project<< Encyclopedia>> He joined the Parcham faction

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A decimal point, space or percent sign inside or next to figures in trial results or census-type statistics.

modes.label: Tartrazine ending
modes.description: The closing part of the dye name tartrazine in a warning about FD&C Yellow No. 5.
modes.example: FD&C Yellow No. 5 (tartr<<azine>>) sensitivity in the general population is low
